versions.changelog:
- Initial release of LangChain Local skill for fully offline, private AI pipelines using Ollama and local models.
- Supports multiple modes: coding (Python/Django), devops (shell commands), chat (conversation), and rag (document-grounded Q&A).
- No API keys or cloud required; runs entirely on your machine with Ollama.
- Easy setup instructions for dependencies and model pulling included.
- Includes example commands and usage parameters for flexible integration.
